item.title: Bill that would ban vaping in indoor public places advances in Alabama
item.description: A bill that would ban vaping in all indoor public places in Alabama advanced in the legislature this week.

item.title: Roads in DeKalb County 'generally passable' after wintry weather moves through
item.description: Unnecessary travel is discouraged, but people who have to drive are asked to do so with caution, especially when braking and accelerating.

item.title: Cullman city council fires wastewater superintendent accused of placing cameras in men's restroom
item.description: The Cullman City Council has fired its wastewater treatment plant superintendent just weeks after he was charged with criminal surveillance.

item.title: Civil rights attorneys hired by man accusing Huntsville police officer of excessive force during arrest
item.description: A man seen being arrested in a video that went viral on social media, leading to a Huntsville police officer being investigated for use-of-force, has hired civil rights attorneys to defend him.

item.title: The Sound of Music to be presented as scheduled in Huntsville this weekend
item.description: This weekend's performances of The Sound of Music will be presented as scheduled, the Broadway Theatre League of Huntsville announced on Saturday.

item.title: Crowd braves winter weather to protest ICE in downtown Huntsville
item.description: Freezing conditions didn't stop hundreds of people from lining Governors Drive in Huntsville Saturday morning to protest Federal Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE).
